findings.summary: Invocation groups retain their primary unit instead of copying stale status and unused fields.
PCH content reads occur only after the complete compilation context is eligible for sharing.
Argument classification constants are allocated once per command instead of once per token.
Array storage admission reuses the JSON initializer transaction without repeating speculative compilation.
Array callback ownership uses consumed snapshot expressions without eager reads, duplicate string copies or copies in intrinsic Boolean predicates.
